title: K01-P-003 whole-part drawing datum namespace for J1 and J2
scope: K01-D-003 drawing semantics only; no CAD geometry or numerical tolerance changes
problem: P003 carries two distinct functional interfaces. Existing local interface documents use A/B/C for J1 P003-P016 and A/B for J2 P003-P007. A single part drawing cannot assign the same datum letter to two different physical datum features.

J1.C: P003 Ø3.02 +0.01/0 THRU clocking hole engaged by relieved P017

decision.mapping_rule: Where J2 source evidence uses local A/B notation for the P003 counterpart, K01-D-003 projects those same physical references as D/E. This is a datum-letter namespace mapping only; it does not alter the referenced surfaces/axes, nominal geometry, tolerance values or assembly function. P007 keeps its own A/B notation on K01-D-006.

basis: EDR-023 controls J1 A/B/C kinematic hierarchy.
EDR-028 controls the P003 J2 physical mating-face/pilot-axis counterpart semantics.
A datum feature identifier must identify one physical datum feature unambiguously within one product drawing.
release_effect: Authorizes K01-D-003 engineering-review authoring with globally unique A/B/C/D/E datum identifiers. Product release remains governed by the underlying interface decisions and open qualification gates.
